newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly Corp says lawsuit has no merit.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly Corp says lawsuit has no merit.

text.p: Donnelly Corp said a lawsuit filed against the company by Midwest Manufacturing Holdings LLC over an alleged breach of breach of a verbal agreement has no merit.

In a statement released late Monday, Donnelly said it told Midwest Manufacturing in mid-January it did not believe a previously discussed sale of Donnelly's Information Products business could be completed.
Midwest alleged that a verbal agreement had been reached and filed a lawsuit seeking to force the company to move forward on the sale, Donnelly said.
Donnelly said it is confident its decision not to go forawrd with the sale will be upheld by the court.
Donnelly shares were trading down 1/8 Tuesday at 17-1/4.
